text.p: These were the main headlines from Lithuania's M-1 plus radio station's news report on Thursday early afternoon. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Parliament passed a money laundering law, obliging banks and other institutions to identify to inform the authorities about supicious banking transactions exceeding 50,000 litas.
- Parliament ratified an agreement between the Lithuanian and Polish governments on the protection of secret military information.
- A 20-years man was electrocuted Wednesday while making home-brewed vodka.
